newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banque Audi shares rally in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Banque Audi shares rally in Beirut.

text.p: Banque Audi shares continued a price rally on Friday on the Beirut stock exchange, trading at $19 from $18.625 a day earlier.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce, the other bank listed on the BSE, held steady at $13.625.
Turnover in Audi shares was 25,000 shares against Thursday's 15,832 and 12,500 BLC shares were traded from 6,875. Also traded was a block of 9,456 BLC shares at 13.5 on the floor.
The LIBX bank index rose 1.00 percent to 118.09.
Solidere shares were steady. A shares traded at $10.25 and B shares were unchanged at $10.75. A total of 207,342 Solidere shares were traded against Thursday's 250,950.
Total BSE turnover was 254,298 shares for a value of $2,930,068 against 279,157 shares for a value of $2,996,962.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais shares, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.07 percent to 901.55 and the LISPI rose 0.20 percent to 83.33.
